summary.text: Peter Egan is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 74 (St. Tammany Parish), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Peter Egan's occupation as Healthcare Owner & Administrator.

The page lists committee assignments including Appropriations, Health and Welfare, Retirement, the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget and the House Select Committee on Homeland Security, and caucus affiliations including the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Rural Caucus and the Northshore Delegation.
